candidates.name: Hereditary Leiomyomatosis and Renal Cell Cancer (HLRCC)
support_spans: Global loss of expression of FH
Next generation sequencing (NGS) detected a pathogenic variant in the FH gene (FHc.999C > A p.Cys333Ter)
Spindle cell tumor composed of elongated cells arranged in long sweeping to poorly formed fascicles
candidates.why: The patient's presentation of a large pelvic mass, uterine fibroids suggested by the clinical context, and the presence of a pathogenic variant in the FH gene support the diagnosis of HLRCC.

candidates.name: Hereditary Leiomyomatosis and Renal Cell Cancer (HLRCC)
support_spans: Global loss of expression of FH
pathogenic variant in the FH gene (FHc.999C > A p.Cys333Ter)
candidates.why: The patient has a pathogenic variant in the FH gene and a history of uterine leiomyomas, which are characteristic of HLRCC.

candidates.name: Uterine Leiomyosarcoma
support_spans: Spindle cell tumor composed of elongated cells arranged in long sweeping to poorly formed fascicles
candidates.why: The histopathological findings of a spindle cell tumor with a diffuse hemangiopericytomatous pattern of vasculature are suggestive of a uterine leiomyosarcoma.

candidates.name: Ovarian Fibroma
support_spans: Findings were suggestive of an ovarian primary
candidates.why: The imaging studies suggest an ovarian primary, and the histopathological findings of a spindle cell tumor are also consistent with an ovarian fibroma.

candidates.name: Hereditary Leiomyomatosis and Renal Cell Cancer (HLRCC)
support_spans: Global loss of expression of FH
Next generation sequencing (NGS) detected a pathogenic variant in the FH gene (FHc.999C > A p.Cys333Ter)
candidates.why: The patient's presentation with a large pelvic mass, uterine fibroids suggested by the clinical context, and the genetic finding of a pathogenic FH gene variant are consistent with HLRCC syndrome.

candidates.name: Uterine Leiomyosarcoma
support_spans: Spindle cell tumor composed of elongated cells arranged in long sweeping to poorly formed fascicles
candidates.why: The histopathological description of the tumor is partially consistent with leiomyosarcoma, but the low MIB-1 labeling index is more suggestive of a benign process.

candidates.name: Leiomyoma
support_spans: Soft to firm, large bosselated mass with restricted mobility arising from pelvis to epigastrium
Diffuse hemangiopericytomatous pattern of vasculature
candidates.why: The clinical and histopathological features, including the diffuse hemangiopericytomatous pattern, are consistent with a diagnosis of leiomyoma, particularly in the context of the patient's presentation with a large pelvic mass and the presence of bilateral breast fibroadenomas.
